strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software Wey Dey Run Van Sales and Sales Reps
strings.tierB.home.description: Software for distributors: invoice and receipt from di rep phone, van stock, money collection, routes and visits. E dey work offline and sync later.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Run your field sales reps from di first visit reach di last collection
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales na cloud platform (van sales and sales rep software) for distribution and wholesale companies wey get sales reps for field. Reps dey issue and print invoice and receipt from dia phone, dem dey track van stock and log visits, while managers dey see sales, collections and wetin each customer dey owe as e dey happen.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoice from di rep phone
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Di rep dey issue di invoice for di customer door and print am for Bluetooth thermal printer bifor e comot from di shop.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Money collection and customer balance
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Every payment get numbered receipt wey link to di invoices wey e pay, and di customer balance and statement go update one time.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Van stock custody
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Di system dey track each van stock item by item: wetin dem load, sell, return and wetin remain, so if anything miss, you go see am di same day.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Routes and visits
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Every visit dey save with location, time and photos, and di manager go see each rep route for map.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: E dey work offline
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Reps go still dey sell even wen network no dey. Documents go wait for di phone and sync by demself wen network come back, without any duplicate.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Web dashboard for managers
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Sales, collections, returns, stock and how each rep dey perform, all for one place, with roles and permissions for every user.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tell us how you dey sell
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Request quote or book meeting. We go look your reps, routes, products and how you dey do invoice.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Set up your company
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Add products, prices, customers and reps, and set your country currency and tax rate for di settings.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Send reps go field
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Reps go install di app for Android or iPhone, load dia van and start to sell, print invoice and collect money.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Follow di day as e dey happen
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Di web dashboard dey show sales, collections, van stock and visits while reps still dey road.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales na cloud platform to manage field sales reps for distribution and wholesale companies. E cover van sales, route sales, pre-sales (order taking) and direct store delivery (DSD). Reps dey do invoice, print, collect money and log visits from dia phone, and managers dey follow sales, collections, van stock and customer balances from web dashboard.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Yes. Di rep app dey work without internet: reps fit issue and print invoice and receipt, log visits and add customers, and everything go sync by imself wen network come back, without any duplicate. One exception dey for Saudi Arabia: companies wey don switch on e-invoicing integration need connection di moment wey dem dey issue invoice or return.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales dey serve distribution companies for every country. Each company dey set im own currency and tax rate for im settings, and invoices, receipts and reports go use dem. FieldSales base for Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and we dey do onboarding online through meetings, WhatsApp and remote support.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales fit connect to government e-invoicing systems?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: We dey support Phase 2 integration with ZATCA’s Fatoora platform. Dis one na for companies for Saudi Arabia. For oda countries, including Nigeria, FieldSales dey issue invoice with your currency and tax rate, and connection to national e-invoicing system dey available on request, afta we check dat country requirements with you. We no dey promise any conformity outside Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Which languages di FieldSales app get?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Di FieldSales app interface dey available for Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese, and na only dis languages. E no get Pidgin interface, but English dey among dem. Reps and managers fit change di interface language, and printed invoice fit carry second language near di main one. Website pages for oda languages, like dis Pidgin page, na translation to give information about di product.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: How I go take start with FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Request quote, book meeting or send us message for WhatsApp. We go learn how your reps dey work, then help you set up products, prices, customers and reps. Reps go install di app for Android or iPhone, and managers go use di web dashboard from any browser. Na only smartphone be di hardware wey you need.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Di FieldSales app interface dey available for Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; Pidgin no dey inside. Pages for oda languages dey describe di product for information only.
strings.tierB.category.title: Van Sales Software for Naija Distributors | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Van sales and route sales software: rep dey print invoice from phone, van stock per item, money collection and visits. E dey work offline.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Van sales software for Naija distributors and wholesalers
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales na van sales software for companies wey dia reps dey sell from van on daily routes. Di rep go load di van, sell for each shop, print di invoice, collect money and record returns, all from one phone app. Di manager go see wetin dem load, sell, collect and wetin remain for every van.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Wetin be van sales software?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Van sales software, wey some pipo dey call cash van or route sales software, na di system for sales model where di rep carry stock for di vehicle and sell, deliver, do invoice and collect money for one visit. E dey replace paper invoice booklet and di phone calls for end of day. E dey record every sale, payment and return as document, so you fit check stock and cash against each oda di same day. For manager, e dey answer three questions every evening: wetin each rep sell, wetin each rep collect, and wetin still remain for each van.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: One day for field
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Di day dey start with documented load from di warehouse enter di van. For each shop, di rep go open di customer page for di app, add items from list or barcode, issue di invoice and print am for thermal printer. Di rep dey record payment with receipt, and log any return with im reason. For end of di day, dem go offload wetin remain for di van back to di warehouse. In between, di manager fit follow each rep sales, collections and visits from di web dashboard without calling anybody.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Built for weak network
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Distribution routes dey pass basements, industrial areas and villages wey network no too dey. Di FieldSales rep app dey keep customers, products and prices for di phone, so di rep fit issue and print documents without internet. Each document get im own unique key, so e go upload only once, even if di app try upload am many times. Saudi companies wey don switch on e-invoicing integration need connection di moment wey dem dey issue invoices and returns. For dem, receipts, visits and new customers still dey work offline.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Collections and van custody
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Cash wey dey road need di same control as stock. Every collection get numbered receipt wey fit link to di invoices wey e pay, and di customer balance go update one time. Van stock dey calculate per item as wetin dem load minus wetin dem sell, plus returns and documented adjustments, so managers fit compare am with physical count bifor di rep go house. Returns fit be normal, damaged or exchange, and di manager go decide whether di returned goods go back enter di van sellable stock.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Who e dey for
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales good for distributors and wholesalers of fast-moving goods (FMCG) like food, drinks, cleaning and personal care products, and any company wey get reps wey dey visit shops, supermarkets and open market on routes. E dey support van sales, pre-sales orders and direct store delivery. E no be full ERP: e dey connect to your accounting or ERP system through API. Managers dey control wetin each rep fit do, like to give discount, sell below list price or add new customers.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Wetin be di difference between van sales and pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: For van sales, di rep carry stock and deliver, do invoice and collect money for di same visit. For pre-sales, di rep take order wey di warehouse go deliver later. FieldSales dey support both, so one company fit run cash vans for some routes and order taking for oda ones. For both models, invoices, collections and customer balances dey inside di same system, and managers dey see dem for di same reports.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: How I go take reconcile van for end of day?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales dey show, for each item for each van, di quantity wey dem load, sell, return and wetin remain. Compare di remaining number with physical count, record any difference as documented adjustment, then offload di rest back to di warehouse with one movement. Di van go start di next day with clean balance wey everybody know.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Wetin rep wey dey sell from van need for hardware?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android or iPhone. Bluetooth thermal printer na optional, e go make di rep fit give di customer printed invoice or receipt. FieldSales no dey sell hardware and e no need any particular printer brand. Managers dey use di web dashboard from any computer or phone browser.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales fit connect to our accounting system?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Yes. FieldSales get API wey go make your accounting or ERP system fit exchange customers, products, invoices, receipts and stock movements with di platform. Your team or your integrator go build di connection with di API documentation.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales for Each Country: Currency, Tax, E-Invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales dey work for distributors for every country. See di currency, sales tax and e-invoicing status for each country inside one table.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: Dem build FieldSales for distribution companies all over di world. Each company dey choose im country, currency and tax rate for im settings, and invoices, receipts and reports go follow dem. Government e-invoicing integration dey live for Saudi Arabia only. For every oda country, e dey available on request. Di table below dey show, for each country, di local currency, di usual sales tax or VAT rate, and whether government e-invoicing connection dey live or e dey available on request.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: We dey support Phase 2 integration with ZATCA’s Fatoora platform
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Na each company dey set currency and tax rate for im own settings. Di rates for dis table na general guide and dem fit change; check di current rules with your tax adviser. Dash (—) mean say no general rate dey listed for dat country.
strings.tierB.about.title: About FieldSales: Who We Be
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales dey build cloud software for distribution companies wey get field sales reps. We start for 2026 for Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (di Arabic name na فيلد سيلز) na cloud platform for distribution and wholesale companies wey get field sales reps. Di company start for 2026 and e base for Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. E dey serve companies for every country, and each company dey set im own country currency and tax rate for im settings. Our customers na companies wey dey sell and deliver through reps for road: distributors, wholesalers and manufacturers wey get dia own sales fleet.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: We dey build one connected system for di whole field cycle: invoice wey rep dey print from phone, receipts and customer balances, van stock custody, routes and visits with location and photos, and web dashboard for managers. Di rep app dey run for Android and iPhone and e dey work without internet, then e go sync wen network come back. Companies fit connect FieldSales to dia accounting or ERP system through API, so nobody go type field data two times.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: We dey describe di product as e be. We dey support Phase 2 integration with ZATCA’s Fatoora platform. Integration with government systems for oda countries dey available on request. Di app interface dey available for Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; Pidgin no dey inside. To tok to us, request quote, book meeting or send us message for WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Contact FieldSales: Tok to Us
strings.tierB.contact.description: Tok to di FieldSales team: request quote, book meeting or chat us for WhatsApp about field sales and van sales software.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tell us how your reps dey sell today and wetin you wan change. Request quote, book meeting or send us message for WhatsApp, and person from our team go reply you. For support, customers wey don dey use FieldSales fit use di same channels. E go help if you tell us your country, how many reps you get, and whether dem dey sell from van, dey take order, or both.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Book online meeting with our team. We go show you how one rep day dey run for di app and wetin di manager dashboard dey show, with examples wey resemble your own products and routes, and we go answer your questions about setup.
